description: We are a team of three from Chile: two astronomers and one software engineer. For the Planet X and SPHEREx challenge we built SPHEREx Blink, a public web tool that shows how the infrared sky changed between SPHEREx visits: an image series like a short video, a view of what got brighter, fainter or moved, and spectra and brightness checks for any object. We combine astronomical data analysis, Python, backend development and web deployment.
